entities.summary: Stefan Karol Jakobielski was a Polish historian, archaeologist, philologist, and epigraphist. One of the pioneers of nubiology. He participated in archaeological research in Faras, Tell Atrib, Palmyra, Deir el-Bahari, and Qasr Ibrim; directed the archaeological works at Old Dongola.
